cross_check: PASS - extended harness agrees with official evaluate.py on shared methods
limitations: One recorded endpoint per architecture; no training seeds, steps/tokens, hardware or exact upstream revision.
The final split is an architecture holdout within this archive, not an independent benchmark.
200 fixed-seed trials measure tie-breaking / random selection variability, not training-seed uncertainty.
Size-controlled pairs overlap and their count is not an independent sample size.
Synthetic reorderings have no trained outcomes and support only structural claims.
protocol: Proposal formula and alpha grid; development-only alpha selection replayed against the original record before final evaluation. Additional diagnostic settings do not change the selected score.

scoring_cost.note: Each cold panel starts with an empty MP cache; its warm panel reuses only that method's cache. Timings exclude copying, ranking and selection. Within-panel repeated matrix shapes share the MP cache.
